events.title: New Zealand Defence Force Confirms Database Breach
events.summary: The New Zealand Defence Force said on 20 November that a database linked to its Force4Families Defence Discounts scheme had been accessed, exposing the names and email addresses of registered users. The intrusion was reported by its website provider; NZDF took affected websites offline, began a forensic investigation and notified the Privacy Commissioner, police and the National Cyber Security Centre. No group has claimed responsibility, and NZDF said it was still determining the full extent of the information affected.

events.title: New Zealand Election Produces No Clear Winner
events.summary: New Zealand's 7 November general election did not produce a decisive result for either the right or the left, according to preliminary results, as voters shifted support from National and Labour to smaller parties. Preliminary results put National and its partners ACT and New Zealand First on track for 67 seats in a projected 131-seat Parliament, where 66 are needed for a majority, with nearly 400,000 special votes still to be counted. Final results are due on 27 November, and Prime Minister Christopher Luxon leads a caretaker government until then.
